// diagnostic L0103

Jet.UnusedImport

Import `{name}` is never used.

What

Import `{name}` is never used.

Why

An unused import adds a name and dependency to the file without contributing to checked code.

Fix

Remove the import, or rename `{name}` to `_{name}` when the import is intentionally kept.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnusedImport: Tests/UI/crypto_secret_local_operations.stderr.

Error: Jet.TraitNotImplemented: `Secret` does not implement `Encode`
  --> Tests/UI/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:20:19
    |
 20 |     encoded: left.encode()
    |                   ^^^^^^
 Why: `.encode()` can only call the value's Encode contract
 Fix: Derive `Encode` on this type, or write its Encode implementation
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.TraitNotImplemented

Error: Jet.UnknownFunction: `Secret` has no method `clone`
  --> Tests/UI/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:21:18
    |
 21 |     cloned: left.clone()
    |                  ^^^^^
 Why: Check the method name on this type
 Fix: No similar method; define it inside `Secret: struct` or `impl Secret`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.UnknownFunction
